description_en: Queries the results of a task that terminates sessions
description_zh: 调用GetKillInstanceSessionTaskResult接口，获取结束会话任务的结果
kebab_example: aliyun das get-kill-instance-session-task-result --instance-id rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000 --task-id f77d535b45405bd462b21caa3ee80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetKillInstanceSessionTaskResult

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

You must specify this parameter if your database instance is a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can obtain the task ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609246.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609246.html接口时返回的任务ID。</props>

<props="intl">任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609246.html接口时返回的任务ID。</props>
parameters.name: task_id

IgnoredUserSessionCount.description_en: The number of ignored sessions, including sessions of the accounts that are specified by IgnoredUsers, sessions of internal O\&M accounts of Alibaba Cloud, and Binlog Dump sessions
IgnoredUserSessionCount.description_zh: 指定的不会被结束的会话数量，包含忽略列表中账号的会话、阿里云内部运维账号的会话和Binlog Dump会话

KillFailCount.description_en: The number of sessions that failed to be terminated

KillSuccessCount.description_en: The number of sessions that were terminated

NodeId.description_en:
The node ID.

This parameter is returned only if the instance is a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
NodeId.description_zh:
节点ID。

PolarDB MySQL版实例的结束会话任务才会返回该数据

Result.description_en: The details of the task that terminated sessions

Active.description_en:
Indicates whether the session is active.

If the type of the command is Query or Execute and the session in the transaction is not terminated, the session is active
Active.description_zh:
是否是活跃会话。

活跃会话判断逻辑： 命令是Query或者Execute，以及未结束事务中的会话

Command.description_en: The type of the command executed in the session

Host.description_en: The IP address and port number of the host that initiated the session
Host.description_zh: 发起该会话主机的IP地址和端口

Info.description_en: The SQL statement executed in the session

Reason.description_en:
The description of the session when the session was terminated.

SESSION_KILLED: The session is terminated.

SESSION_EXPIRED: The session has expired.

SESSION_NO_PERMISSION: The account used to terminate the session has insufficient permissions.

SESSION_ACCOUNT_ERROR: The account or password used to terminate the session is invalid.

SESSION_IGNORED_USER: The session of the account does not need to be terminated.

SESSION_INTERNAL_USER_OR_COMMAND: The session is a session initiated by or a command run by an Alibaba Cloud O\&M account.

SESSION_KILL_TASK_TIMEOUT: Timeout occurs when the session is terminated.

SESSION_OTHER_ERROR: Other errors occurred
Reason.description_zh:
结束该会话时的结果描述。
SESSION_KILLED：结束会话成功。
SESSION_EXPIRED：会话已过期。
SESSION_NO_PERMISSION：用于结束会话的账号权限不足。
SESSION_ACCOUNT_ERROR：用于结束会话的账号或密码错误。
SESSION_IGNORED_USER：不需要结束的账号的会话。
SESSION_INTERNAL_USER_OR_COMMAND：阿里云运维账号的会话或者命令。
SESSION_KILL_TASK_TIMEOUT：结束会话超时。
SESSION_OTHER_ERROR：其他错误

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the subtask that terminates the session

Sessions.description_en:
The session IDs.

If all sessions are terminated, the IDs of all sessions on the instance or node are returned
Sessions.description_zh:
需要结束的会话ID列表。

结束全部会话时，实例或节点上的所有会话ID列表

TaskState.description_en:
The state of the task that terminates sessions.

RUNNING: The task is in progress.

SUCCESS: The task is successful.

FAILURE: The task failed.

ERROR: Other errors occur
TaskState.description_zh:
结束会话任务的状态：

RUNNING：正在运行。
SUCCESS：成功。
FAILURE：失败。
ERROR：其他错误

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
